sentences: What would you like to talk about today?
I went swimming on Sunday, and I got water up my nose when I tried to turn at the end of the pool.
We had to do a route without using the blue holds.
My instructor, Rob, and two other people from the Tuesday group.
At the climbing centre in Leeds.
The indoor one by the retail park.
The blue holds were taped off.
You could use the green ones and the red ones, but not the blue ones.
Rob said it was to make us plan where our feet went.
What happened when you tried it?
I got to the middle and couldn't reach the next green hold.
I tried moving my left foot up, but it kept slipping.
What was that like for you?
I thought I was going to have to come down without finishing it.
I went back down one hold and put my foot on the red one instead.
So you changed your foot placement and found another way up.
How did you feel when you got to the top?
I didn't think I'd manage it.
What happened after you'd finished the route?
Rob said I could try it again if I wanted, but I said no because my arms were tired.
And how did the session end?
We did stretches and then everyone got their bags.
Rob set the route with the blue holds out of use.
You struggled at the middle, moved your foot to a red hold, and reached the top.
You felt pleased with yourself, but your arms were tired, so you didn't repeat it.
Then you all stretched and got your bags.
Is there another detail you'd like to add?
Can I book the same slot next Tuesday?
